summary: Answered both of the owner's 14 Nov notes at their source (scripts that reveal how the money is made; global Shorts only about brands known everywhere), adopted two fixes (links in descriptions, sources named instead of 'illustrative numbers') and made the layout gate catch signs cut by a push-in. Weekly loop cycle 1 still waits for data.
why: The owner's notes come first; QA's top failure (edge cuts, 29 videos) had a clear cause in the probe; the Shorts challenger has no Shorts with 48 h data yet.

findings.title: Cycle 1 waiting
findings.detail: real-subject-first-frame: on 0, off 0 Shorts with 48 h data (day 1 of 7). Long tests: quiet-bed 1 of 4, chart-gap-fill 2 of 4.

findings.title: Weekly impact
findings.detail: Week of 9 Nov (n 6): median 48 h views 56.5, 74.1% viewed, stayed to watch 0.308, 19.9 s average view; week of 2 Nov (n 8): 43, 51.2%, 0.381, 21.9 s. People who stay watch more, but fewer stay.

findings.title: What performs
findings.detail: Stories how_they_make_money 2.97x (n 8), secret_of_rich 2.76x (n 7); hook challenge 3.21x (n 4), question 0.40x (n 15); 20-24 s Shorts 4.72x (n 3); music cinematic 67.7% viewed, acoustic 0.23x.

findings.title: Top recurring failure: edge cuts (29 videos, 14 days)
findings.detail: Flat-kit deco print was skipped by the layout probe, so signs cut by a push-in reached QA. On v-20261114-02 the new gate finds 'MEMBERS' cut to 'EMBERS' and 'LANE TWO' cut to 'WO'.

changes.title: Shorts reveal how the money is made
changes.detail: Owner note on the Las Vegas Short: story.curiosity_problems fails a unit ladder (3+ time rates), writer/hook judge/zoom-in shape ask for the mechanism.

changes.title: Global Shorts only about brands known everywhere
changes.detail: Owner note on the Costco Short: reach.check_plan fails one-country brands in a global plan; planner prompt and the everyday-brands challenger updated.

changes.title: Links are not claims (2026-11-14-links-not-claims)
